instanceFunctions.clearInputBuffer: Fully clears this Character's input buffer. Character input buffers are handled automatically, so this function doesn't need to be ran unless you are interacting with the input buffer yourself.
instanceFunctions.getAirdashCount: Returns the number of airdashes this Character has performed since leaving the ground.
instanceFunctions.getAssistCharge: Returns the amount of assist charge this Character currently has. Result is a float between 0 and 1; 0 represents an empty bar and 1 a full bar.
instanceFunctions.getAssistContentStat:
Returns the value of any attribute defined for this Character's assist. These attributes are found in the script associated with the assist's `objectStatsId` (defined in `manifest.json`, usually ends up being `AssistStats.hx`).

Parameters:

- The name of the attribute to retrieve the value of.
instanceFunctions.getAssistController: Returns the [AssistController](AssistController.md) associated with this Character's assist.
instanceFunctions.getAssistName: Returns the `resourceID` of this Character's assist.
instanceFunctions.getAssist: Returns an array containing the `resourceID` of all assists associated with this Character. Is functionally the same as [getAssistName](#getassistname-string), with the return value being the first element in the returned array.
instanceFunctions.getCharacterStat: Returns the value of any attribute defined for this Character. These attributes are found in the script associated with the Character's `objectStatsId` (defined in `manifest.json`, usually ends up being `CharacterStats.hx`).
instanceFunctions.getDamageCounterAssistSprite: Returns the [Sprite](Sprite.md) used in the Character's damage counter's assist progress bar.
instanceFunctions.getDoubleJumpCount: Returns the number of double jumps this Character has performed.
instanceFunctions.getFoes: Returns an array of all Character class instances in the match that aren't this Character.
instanceFunctions.getLives: Returns the number of stocks this Character currently has.
instanceFunctions.getPlayerConfig: Returns the [PlayerConfig](PlayerConfig.md) associated with this Character.
instanceFunctions.getScore: Returns the [Score](Score.md) associated with this Character.
instanceFunctions.getType: Returns the type of this Character. For Character, this returns `6`.
instanceFunctions.inAerialAttackState: Returns `true` if this Character is currently in an attacking state while in the air.
instanceFunctions.inAirdashCanceledAnimation: Returns `true` if this Character was in an airdash state before their currently playing animation.
instanceFunctions.inHurtState: Returns `true` if this Character is currently in a hurt state.
instanceFunctions.inSpecialAttackState: Returns `true` if this Character is currently in an attack state due to performing a special attack. This carries over to the special attack's `landAnimation` if defined.
instanceFunctions.inStrongAttackChargeState: Returns `true` if this Character is currently charging a strong attack.
instanceFunctions.isForcedGetup: Returns `true` if this Character is being forced into [CState.CRASH_GET_UP](CState.md#cstate-crash-get-up). Usually happens after a "jab lock."
instanceFunctions.performHitstopNudge:
Nudges this Character in the corresponding direction when they are currently in hitstop.

Parameters:
- `up`, `down`, `left`, and `right` are the direction to nudge towards.
- `nudgeMultiplier` is the amount to multiply the nudge amount by.
instanceFunctions.playAttackVoice: Plays one of the audio files defined in this Character's `attackVoiceIds`, defined in the script associated with Character's `objectStatsId` (defined in `manifest.json`, usually ends up being `CharacterStats.hx`).
instanceFunctions.playHurtHeavyVoice: Plays one of the audio files defined in this Character's `hurtHeavyVoiceIds`, defined in the script associated with Character's `objectStatsId` (defined in `manifest.json`, usually ends up being `CharacterStats.hx`).
instanceFunctions.playHurtLightVoice: Plays one of the audio files defined in this Character's `hurtLightVoiceIds`, defined in the script associated with Character's `objectStatsId` (defined in `manifest.json`, usually ends up being `CharacterStats.hx`).
instanceFunctions.playHurtMediumVoice: Plays one of the audio files defined in this Character's `hurtMediumVoiceIds`, defined in the script associated with Character's `objectStatsId` (defined in `manifest.json`, usually ends up being `CharacterStats.hx`).
instanceFunctions.playKoVoice: Plays one of the audio files defined in this Character's `koVoiceIds`, defined in the script associated with Character's `objectStatsId` (defined in `manifest.json`, usually ends up being `CharacterStats.hx`).
instanceFunctions.setAirdashCount:
Sets the number of airdashes this Character has performed.

Parameters:
- The new value to set the airdash count to.
instanceFunctions.setAssistCharge:
Sets this Character's assist charge.

Parameters:
- The new value to set the assist charge to.
instanceFunctions.setAssistCutinAnimation:
Sets the animation used when summoning an assist. Valid animations are in the entity associated with the assist's `metadata.ui.entityId` (defined in `manifest.json`, usually `menu.entity`).

Parameters:
- The name of the animation to use.
instanceFunctions.setDoubleJumpCount:
Sets the number of double jumps this Character has performed.

Parameters:
- The new value to set the double jump count to.
instanceFunctions.setLives:
Sets the number of stocks this Character has.

Parameters:
- The new stock amount.
instanceFunctions.updateAnimationStats:
Updates this Character's [CharacterAnimationStats](CharacterAnimationStats.md).

Parameters:
- The new values for each [CharacterAnimationStats](CharacterAnimationStats.md). You only have to include the stats you want to modify.
